trigger.description: Tier-aware cache prewarm was given memory tier assignments whose generation is older than the current workspace/cache generation. The prewarm report rejects the tier metadata instead of using stale hot/warm/cold residency hints.
trigger.invocation: Build a tier-aware prewarm report with tier_generation lower than the current prewarm generation.

expected_emission.repair_string: Regenerate memory tier assignments before running tier-aware prewarm.
